$themes.name: Light
$themes.$description: The painted default: every docs.x.ai page boots html.light (next-themes reads localStorage.theme) — a white ground, near-black ink, the solar orange accent.

$themes.name: Dark
$themes.$description: The painted dark surface: the header's 'Switch to dark theme' button flips html.dark and .dark/:root.dark re-point the semantic roles — #0a0a0a ground, #d5d9e2 ink. A few names (--border, --input, --ring, --alert, --on-alert, --background-*, --content-*, --sb-*) exist in dark only.
